title: Data Migration
subtitle: Comprehensive, Structured Data Conversion Services
descHeading: Fully searchable, cleansed, condensed, and standardized legacy data
descContent: CSI uses an iterative development method to ensure that legacy data appears as if it was entered originally in the new system. There’s no need to access a separate database or system to find the legacy data. Everything is unified under one database and platform. Over the years, we have used our systematic method to successfully convert legacy data for more than thirty different systems.

diagram.desc: CSI offers the most structured and comprehensive data migration services on the market. We use a tried-and-tested proprietary process to analyze and transfer legacy data to the new system. The original data is not simply copied but also cleansed, condensed, and standardized. In InfoShare™, a unique person exists a single consolidated record. Users never have to re-enter old data or remove duplicate entries. Some vendors create independent functions to access the legacy data, whereas others handle the data migration process with much less effort, resulting in inconsistent and messy data. By contrast, CSI develops tools and strategies to offer high quality data migration with data integrity assurance.

title: Data Analytics
subtitle: Transforming Data and Analysis into Actionable Insights
descHeading: Data-driven decision making, resource tracking, and reporting
descContent: Government agencies generate and collect enormous amounts of data every single day. In order to make sense of all this information, CSI's Data Analytics transforms this raw data into actionable insights using data statistics, custom query reporting, and data visualization tools. Analytics also reveals relationships, trends, and patterns of criminal activity to assist public service professionals in intelligent decision-making and efficient resource allocation.

diagram.desc: With CSI’s data visualization and analytics tools, public safety professionals can configure high-level dashboards for organizational and response planning, run multidimensional crime analysis, and instantly generate actionable insights. Advanced reporting tools enable users to create customizable reports and save report templates with custom search criteria. And custom querying allows users to choose the exact information to analyze, visualize, and/or disseminate. All these solutions are integrated into our InfoShare™ products.

features.desc: Our Data Analytics solutions are fully integrated into the InfoShare Engine® platform. From global search to trend analysis to reporting, agencies have access to a comprehensive toolkit to make strategic, intelligence-led decisions.

title: Mapping
subtitle: Location Intelligence with GIS Technology
descHeading: Integrated mapping capability for accurate location verification, real-time tracking, and better data analysis
descContent: Interactive GIS mapping technology is directly integrated into the InfoShare™ Engine to assist with dispatch, unit location tracking, unit recommendations, geo-verification, crime mapping, multidimensional data analysis, search, and other functions. It supports multiple mapping platforms such as Bing, Google, and ArcGIS with several view options and customizable map layers.

diagram.desc: Mapping technology has a wide range of applications that facilitate better decision-making. Traditional systems without GIS assistance lack valuable location intelligence and data visualization. Mapping in InfoShare™ is used by a range of different products including CAD (incident location, unit recommendation, GPS, AVL), RMS (crime analysis, master location index), FIRE & EMS (unit monitoring, location information), and Analytics (heat mapping, multidimensional analysis), to name a few.

title: Cloud Integration
subtitle: Mature Hybrid Cloud-Ready Applications for Speed and Security
descHeading: Cloud-based software suite with scaled up resources, enhanced data sharing, and low-cost operations
descContent: CSI has considerable expertise in cloud migration services. We leverage the power of cloud computing to help agencies transfer their operations to CJIS-compliant cloud platforms. But CSI’s cloud integration isn’t limited to scaling up resources and improving government capabilities. InfoShare™ Cloud also enhances data sharing and application design. All products and modules within InfoShare™ are integrated and cloud-deployable, creating a cohesive enterprise application platform designed specifically for the unique needs of the public sector.

diagram.desc: InfoShare™ Cloud brings multiple cloud environments together to create scalable, reliable, and low-cost applications operating as a single, cohesive IT infrastructure. Our integration supports public, private, and hybrid cloud requirements hosted on the CJIS-compliant AWS GovCloud or Azure Government—both designed for maximum government security. Traditional application integration is complex, expensive, and not to mention, resource-intensive. They typically lack flexibility and have limited storage. CSI’s cloud integration with robust security authentication and permission policies yields many advantages including scalability, unlimited storage, improved performance, enhanced user experience, and substantial cost savings in maintenance and deployment.

title: Vertical Integration
subtitle: From Public Safety to Municipal Services to Judiciary and Regulatory Agencies
descHeading: Vertically integrated solutions for end-to-end service from call handling to case disposition
descContent: Eliminate information silos, improve data sharing, and take full control of the incident workflow with CSI’s unified software suite. The law enforcement and criminal justice process is complex and dynamic: call handling, dispatch, intelligence, field response, reporting, evidence, investigation, analysis, arrest, indictment, trial, sentencing, and potential imprisonment. With our vertically integrated product lines, information is transferred and exchanged seamlessly among different public servants and multiple government agencies.

diagram.desc: Vertical integration enables organizations to completely control the incident workflow, maximizing efficiency, collaboration, and safety. Most vendors only deliver solutions to one or two stages of the complete criminal justice and public safety process. Agencies need to work with multiple vendors and pay them exorbitant fees for integration and interfacing. In comparison, CSI’s vertical integration strategy ensures seamless data transfer across all product lines and eliminates the need for agencies to combine the products themselves.

title: Security
subtitle: Robust data encryption, permission, and protection
descHeading: Integrated security methodology compliant with industry security standards
descContent: CSI’s security policy ensures continuity of criminal justice information protection, from creation through dissemination, at rest or in transit and passes the stringent third-party penetration test. Integrated GovCloud security features are fully compliant with CJIS (Criminal Justice Information Services), FIPS (Federal Information Processing Standards), IRS Safeguards Audit, and other government security standards.

diagram.desc: Effective security methodology eliminates security risks and vulnerabilities defined in Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP) Top 10 to ensure that sensitive criminal justice information is fully protected. Traditional applications lack robust security controls and are vulnerable to SQL injection, XSS, and other attacks. With integrated government cloud security features and strict authority control, CSI’s security mechanism is fully compliant with CJIS rules, FIPS, IRS Safeguards Audit Requirements, and other national security requirements.
